Theorem
[Converse to mean-value property]

↗ def:harmonic-function

1. ch2:2.2-thm-3\group Harmonic Functions

If $u\in C^2(U)$ and \[ u(x)=\fint _{\partial B(x,r)}u\, dS \] for every $B(x,r)\subset U$, then $u$ is harmonic.
Proof

\sketch The preceding differentiation formula makes every spherical average constant in $r$. If $\Delta u(x_0)\ne 0$, after replacing $u$ by $-u$ if needed, $\Delta u>0$ on a small ball about $x_0$, contradicting $0=\phi '(r)=\frac rn\fint _{B(x_0,r)}\Delta u$.

□
